validation.rootTestsNote: Isolated host-root run: DSH_CONTROLS_HOST_ROOT plus the checksum-bound accepted tarball, so no environment-gated host integration case was skipped. A plain node --test without that host seam reports 795 cases with 288 environment-gated skips.
validation.featureEvidence: S now answers the operator's question directly: it counts subagents that are running. v0.4.20 had parked a disposed continuable child as `unknown`, which kept the slot occupied after the run ended and still reported a number that was not the running count; the operator rejected that semantics. The implementation now follows the window's purpose. A run ending still releases the slot (`released`), because that instance is genuinely not running and `released -> running` is rejected as a regression by the window state machine; when the durable session is woken again and its Agent is re-created, the plugin re-admits the same executionId through a fresh reservation (new generation and leaseId, which windows.ts explicitly supports for a released execution), re-attaches the new instance, and receipts `running`, so the woken lane occupies a slot again. A wake that matches no known unreleased binding is still reported as unmanaged native activity. The input-area progress now reads `S <running>/<cap>` (degrading to `S 在跑 <n>/<cap> · 总数未知` when unmanaged native activity makes the count a lower bound) and the `（参考）` hedge after the ratios is gone; the separate note that these windows are accounting observations rather than hard quotas remains. Locked by the delegation test, which asserts that a finished run frees its slot, that the wake re-admits the same execution as a new generation, and that the wake is not reported as unmanaged.

review.independentReview: none: the semantics were corrected directly from the operator's statement of the window's purpose; the previous behaviour was falsified by their own reading of the live panel, and the new rule is locked by the updated delegation test plus the client summary assertions
